statutes.title: Definition of Resident (Non-Temporary Purpose Test)
statutes.breadcrumbs: Cal. Rev. & Tax Code > Part 10 > Chapter 1 > § 17014
text_en: Defines resident as every individual who is in California for other than a temporary or transitory purpose, and every individual domiciled in California who is outside the state for a temporary or transitory purpose. Presumption under § 17016 at 9 months.
text_es: Define residente como todo individuo que permanezca en California para fines que no sean temporales o transitorios, y todo domiciliado que esté fuera del estado de forma temporal. Aplica el criterio de conexión más cercana.

statutes.title: Individual Income Tax Rates and Brackets
statutes.breadcrumbs: Cal. Rev. & Tax Code > Part 10 > Chapter 2 > § 17041
text_en: Imposes graduated income tax rates on California taxable income ranging from 1% to 12.3%, plus the 1% surcharge under R&TC § 17043 on taxable income exceeding $1,000,000 (Mental Health Services Tax through 2024; Behavioral Health Services Tax from 2025), creating a top marginal individual rate of 13.3%.
text_es: Grava el ingreso tributable de California con tasas escalonadas del 1% al 12.3%, más el recargo de 1% bajo R&TC § 17043 sobre ingreso tributable mayor a $1,000,000 (Mental Health Services Tax hasta 2024; Behavioral Health Services Tax desde 2025), para una tasa marginal máxima de 13.3%.

statutes.title: Gross Income of Nonresidents and Sourcing
statutes.breadcrumbs: Cal. Rev. & Tax Code > Part 10 > Chapter 9 > § 17951
text_en: In the case of nonresidents, gross income includes only gross income from sources within California, including income from a business, trade, or profession conducted in the state, and compensation for personal services performed in California.
text_es: Para no residentes, el ingreso bruto comprende únicamente ingresos derivados de fuentes en California, incluyendo negocios, profesiones y servicios personales realizados dentro del estado.

statutes.title: FTB Residence and Domicile Guidelines
text_en: FTB regulation detailing domicile and residence determination. A person may have multiple residences but only one domicile. Applies the closest connection test evaluating real property, family, bank accounts, business affiliations, and licenses.
text_es: Reglamento de la FTB sobre residencia y domicilio. Aplica el criterio de conexión más cercana evaluando propiedades inmuebles, familia, cuentas bancarias, licencias profesionales y afiliaciones comerciales.
